title: 2004 Year of the Monkey First Day Cover USA 37¢ Stamp San Francisco FDI Envelope
descriptionText:
2004 USPS First Day Cover featuring the Year of the Monkey stamp with official San Francisco first day of issue cancellation dated January 13, 2004.
Envelope is clean and unaddressed with crisp cancellation mark. Great addition for stamp collectors or zodiac-themed collections.
See photos for exact condition.
